_comment: Costs are costs: 'Discard a zombie, destroy this' gates the activation (DISCARD_CARD can_pay requires a Zombie in hand - 'Zombie' is a subtype on the zombie ally cards, read via _hand_card_filter; DESTROY_SELF resolves the arms slot via canonical destroy). No damage_type on PREVENT_DAMAGE is deliberate - the text prevents any damage. Two known engine fidelity gaps, documented on sibling cards (well_grounded, misfire_dampener reviews) and true here too: the shield is consumed whole by the first damage event even if it absorbs less than 2, and an unused shield has no end-of-turn expiry because the type takes no span param - so prevention bought this turn can leak into later turns.
